question: Does pulling the goalie at an offensive-zone faceoff tie more games?
answer: There is no clear effect. After the model adjustment, OZ-draw pulls tie +1.0 points more often than other pulls (CI -2.8 to 4.7).
findings: Down 1 on an OZ draw, teams are level at 60:00 16.1% of the time against 14.5% expected (n=435, median 2:16 left).
Down 1 on the fly, it is 12.7% against 12.2% expected (n=1,320, median 1:46 left).
A goal for comes before the goalie returns 13% of the time after an OZ draw and 12% on the fly.
Down 1 and 2 pooled: +0.1 points (-2.0 to 2.3), n=3,258.
method: The outcome is being level or ahead at 60:00, minus the Markov model's expectation for the pull time (stay pulled). The first even-strength pull per team-game, with the zone taken from a faceoff within 2 s of the goalie leaving. Bootstrap CIs.
data: NHL API play-by-play + shift charts, regular seasons 2021-22 to 2024-25, 5,248 games; 1,801 pulls down 1.
split_check: The OZ-draw residual down 1 was +3.7 points in 2021-23 and -0.5 points in 2023-25.

chart.title: Level at 60:00 after a pull, by how it started
